g.text: End to end, charging DiLoCo 2.49× the steps to reach 3.28

rect.style: stroke-width: 1px; stroke: rgb(0, 0, 0); stroke-opacity: 0; fill: rgb(0, 0, 0); fill-opacity: 0;

text.style: font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; fill: rgb(85, 85, 85); fill-opacity: 1; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: DiLoCo bars are reconstructed: measured DiLoCo compute plus this transport's
measured all-reduce divided by H=500. The 2.49× step ratio is §18's
estimate — DiLoCo never actually reached 3.28 inside this corpus.
